settlement_source: Governing League (nfl.com) then ESPN, CBS, Fox, NBC, AP, WSJ, broadcaster. First official final result; corrections after expiration ignored.
settlement_variable: Team scores strictly more points over the full game incl. OT. expiration_value 'winner'.
timezone: ET per terms; API UTC; API scheduled expiration fields don't match the PDF's 10:00 AM ET.
tie_handling: No Tie strike -> tie settles BOTH team markets at $0.50 to YES and NO (rules_secondary explicit). Regular-season ties are real outcomes.
trading_close_vs_settlement: can_close_early: 'will close and expire after a winner is declared'; observed close at the final with ~6 min to settlement; ~200 fills at 0.99 printed up to ~59 s AFTER recorded close_time (back-dated). KCSEA tape: 0.95 at T-26 min, 0.99 at T-22 min; final 20 min pinned 0.99/1.00.
early_close_or_void_clauses: Postponed within 48 h -> stands; not started within 48 h -> last fair price; abandoned before 55 min of play -> last fair price, after 55 min or league-final -> score at that point; forfeit before kickoff -> last fair price, after -> league result; venue change rules; DQ/vacated rules; Market Outcome Review 7.1. No void/refund ever — catch-all is discretionary 'last fair price'.
title_vs_rules_divergences: Original date not binding (48 h window), beyond -> fair price
